summary: John's 3rd-great-grand-uncle (brother of Addison); a 13-year-old slate picker in 1880.
bio: Orange Pringle was 13 and a slate picker - a breaker boy sitting over the chutes picking slate out of the coal - in the 1880 census (FamilySearch: 1870-1917). In 1910 his mother Catherine Scott lived with him at Larksville.
sources: 1880 US census, Plymouth Twp (E. Dist., 3d Div.), Luzerne Co., ED 145, p.4, enumerated 4 Jun 1880: https://ancestors.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/sources/LHHH-W68/images/i/0/image.jpg ; record https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MWNZ-S9X
Bradsby 1893, Catherine Scott sketch (p.~1327), PAGenWeb transcription: https://pagenweb.org/~luzerne/bios/sabios.htm
